identity: EXPLORATORY ONLY; NON_AUTHORITATIVE; PRE-OUTCOME SEMANTIC CLARIFICATION; NO OUTCOME COMPUTATION
reason: Pre-outcome executor review found under-specified mechanics and classification language.
scope: Semantic clarification only; this artifact does not rewrite the preregistration or alter data.

universe.weights: equal weight, +1 total long and -1 total short

semantic_closure_matrix.resolution: At UTC daily close t, H012/H013 score is close[t]/close[t-lookback]-1 and is finite only when both prices are finite. H014 score is the sum of every settled funding event dated in the inclusive UTC daily window ending t; every daily cell in that window must be present. H015 is the latest hourly premium observation dated t, available only after that UTC daily close.
Rank descending by raw score; apply each frozen direction only to long-minus-short weights. No score exists before its complete lookback; unavailable features do not change universe membership.

Use only the frozen daily ledger selected_symbols at close t. Its 90 finite-close and 30 finite-volume-day rules, trailing median quote volume, descending liquidity rank, and lexicographic symbol tie-break are authoritative.

Rank finite, eligible scores descending, ties lexicographically by symbol. Let n be finite ranked names and k=max(1,floor(0.2*n)); form a book only if n>=10 and n>=2*k. Long first k and short last k receive +direction/k and -direction/k; all other weights are zero.

Decision uses information through close t; weights effective for close[t] to close[t+1]. A leg earns a price return only when both closes are finite and adjacent ledger dates are consecutive UTC calendar dates. Otherwise it earns zero price return and its forced-close flag is reported; no gap return is bridged.

New names enter only when selected in the t ledger. If an existing held leg lacks the next close, it is set to zero at t+1 with turnover charged against the last known weight, no imputed exit price, and an unresolved forced-close flag. A nonzero flag causes uninterpretable_delisting to be reported, not silently classified.

For each held interval, include each actual settled event timestamped after close t and through close t+1; cashflow is -weight times funding_rate. Positive funding is paid by a long. Missing event/source data produces no imputed cashflow and is reported as missing; factor-window incompleteness already excludes ranking.

At every portfolio change including initial entry, exit to flat, forced close, and re-entry, turnover is sum(abs(weight_new-weight_old)); fee is turnover*cost_bps/10000. Apply independently at 5, 10, and 20 bps; no other costs are inferred.

Daily IC is Spearman correlation of finite score and close[t] to close[t+1] return among names eligible at t with a valid adjacent return. Ties receive stable ordinal ranks after lexicographic symbol ordering. IC is missing below 2 observations or with zero rank variance; report mean, median, positive-hit rate, count, and every daily value without imputing missing IC.

Report calendar segments 2020-01-01 through 2020-12-31, 2021-01-01 through 2023-12-31, and 2024-01-01 through 2026-06-30. Also report every rolling 180 consecutive eligible-return observations, with start/end dates and metrics. These are reports, not newly invented pass thresholds.

Weekly sensitivity consists of all seven UTC weekday anchors. Each scheduled date decides at that day's close and uses the same daily causal score, universe, breadth, ranking, construction, gap, funding, and 5/10/20-bps rules. It holds until the next occurrence of that same anchor. Invalid scheduled formation retains the prior valid weekly portfolio subject to gap/delisting rules, or remains flat if none exists. Report every anchor plus median, minimum, maximum, positive-anchor count, and dispersion (max-min); never select or headline the best anchor.

Use 100 deterministic iid Uniform[0,1) score matrices from NumPy default_rng(20260728), one reproducible stream split sequentially into draw indices 0..99. Each draw uses the observed date-by-date eligibility panel and exact bucket rule, then the same execution and all cost conventions. For each factor/cost report observed load-bearing net cumulative return, null mean, median, 2.5/25/75/97.5 percentiles, empirical rank, percentile, and fraction of null draws >= observed. No p-value or threshold is introduced.

Report asset contribution as sum over valid intervals of weight*price_return plus funding cashflow, separately for total, long, and short legs; report each contribution share of signed total when nonzero and absolute-contribution share otherwise. Report period contributions for the three calendar segments and rolling-180 windows. No concentration threshold is invented.
